newsitem.title: POLAND: Swarzedz plans new share issue.
newsitem.headline: Swarzedz plans new share issue.

text.p: The board of the Polish furniture maker Swarzedz SA will ask shareholders at an extraordinary meeting on February 8 to approve a new share issue, Swarzedz said in a statement on Monday.
It gave no further details, but the firm has earlier said it was considering a share or bond issue to pay for its debts.

The company had a 33.7 million zloty net loss in the first 11 months of 1996. Its main creditors are PBR, Bank Ochrony Srodowiska SA, Bank Gdanski and Powszechny Bank Gospodarczy SA. Swarzedz did not disclose the size of its debts. -- Warsaw Newsroom +48 22 653 9700
